page.content:
Arashikage ninja who fights for Cobra and later beside Snake Eyes.

How Storm Shadow connects

  • Character: Snake Eyes — Snake Eyes and Storm Shadow are Arashikage brothers turned rivals.
  • Faction: Cobra — Storm Shadow serves Cobra as an Arashikage ninja before later breaking away.

What is Storm Shadow?

Storm Shadow is Thomas S. Arashikage, the white-suited ninja whose clan bond with Snake Eyes, Cobra service, and later defection is the longest personal feud in A Real American Hero.

Key threads lead to Snake Eyes and Cobra.
